wool_hero.description: Soft organic folds of luxury cream and camel ribbed cashmere knitwear in warm moody light with unmistakable ribbed knit structure and cashmere drape.

wool_drape.description: Stacked heavy-knit sweaters showing rich oatmeal and ribbed knit stitches in warm, dim ambient lighting.

wool_knit_macro.description: Extreme macro close-up of deep burgundy chunky loop knit stitches with visible yarn loops and hand-crafted texture.

wool_yarn.description: Close-up of natural cream wool yarn skeins showing soft twisted fibers and organic yarn strand structure.

wool_cable_knit.description: Clean close-up of chunky cable knit white wool fabric with bold interlocking knit loops and prominent stitch definition.

wool_craft_burgundy.description: Hand-knitting process in dark burgundy yarn on needles, clearly highlighting individual V-stitch knitted rows and wool craftsmanship.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use these exact Unsplash image URLs for the Wool & Whispers case-study page. Ensure every visual asset clearly emphasizes knitted textures, loop stitches, yarn strands, and cashmere drapes instead of flat woven fabrics.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Include data-testid on all interactive elements. Ensure high contrast against #24070A dark moody background using cream text (#FDFBF7).
